page_title: Logging of Changes to Contract Account
text_raw:
Logging of Changes to Contract Account
Logging of Changes to Contract Account
Use
Changes to fields of the contract account are logged. The changes can be displayed in the dialog maintenance of the contract account. It also contains information about who created a contract account when, and who made the last change.
Key Features
In the menu, choose the transaction
Extras
and then choose the desired menu entry in the following table.
Menu Entry
The system displays the following:
Creation Data
Who created a contract account when and last changed it
There is a difference here between general and business-partner-specific data.
Account Changes
All the changes to an account.
During execution, the system offers a selection list of all fields that have previously been changed on the account. In addition, the system displays cross-business-partner and business-partner-specific details regarding the creation data of the account, and additional data on business partners.
By selecting individual fields, you can select the change data. After confirming the entries, a list of all the changes appears, specifying the person who made them and the date of the change.
Field Changes
Changes to the field on which the cursor is positioned.
After choosing this function, a list with the changes made to this field appears, specifying the person who made them and the date of the change.
No change documents are written for process locks. You can display the history for the display locks from the dialog for the locks
